existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may charge a fee not to exceed twenty-five cents per standard page for a copy of a public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester seeks a copy on a standard page
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A custodian may charge a fee not to exceed twenty-five cents per standard page for a copy of a public record or a fee not to exceed the actual cost of providing a copy, printout, or photograph of a public record in a format other than a standard page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: State sets a ceiling ($0.25/standard page); the municipality supplies the operative value at or below it. constraint_basis=ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a copy, printout, or photograph in a format other than a standard page, the custodian may charge a fee not to exceed the actual cost of providing it.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy provided in a format other than a standard page
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: ... a fee not to exceed the actual cost of providing a copy, printout, or photograph of a public record in a format other than a standard page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Actual-cost ceiling for non-standard formats; municipality supplies the operative charge under the cap.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: After the first hour, the custodian may charge a fee for research and retrieval of public records not to exceed thirty dollars per hour.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Research and retrieval time exceeds the first free hour
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: After the first hour of time has been expended, the custodian may charge a fee for the research and retrieval of public records that shall not exceed thirty dollars per hour.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: The $30/hour statutory ceiling is periodically adjusted for inflation by the Director of Research of the Legislative Council (the current CPI-adjusted maximum is higher than $30 and should be pulled from the current published figure). constraint_basis=ceiling; municipality sets its own rate at or below the current maximum.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: First hour of research and retrieval free
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian shall not impose any charge for the first hour of time expended in research and retrieval of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Research and retrieval performed on a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Under any such policy, the custodian shall not impose a charge for the first hour of time expended in connection with the research and retrieval of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed statutory free allowance (1 hour). Not municipally variable — constraint_basis=fixed.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Published fee policy prerequisite to charging research/retrieval fees
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A custodian may impose a research-and-retrieval fee only if, before receiving the request, it has posted on its website or otherwise published a written policy specifying the applicable conditions and the amount of any current fee.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Custodian intends to charge a research-and-retrieval fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A custodian may impose a fee in response to a request for the research and retrieval of public records only if the custodian has, prior to the date of receiving the request, either posted on the custodian's website or otherwise published a written policy that specifies the applicable conditions concerning the research and retrieval of public records by the custodian, including the amount of any current fee.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Gating precondition: no published policy => no research/retrieval fee may be charged. Structural prerequisite the engine must check before applying the fee parameter.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No transmission fee for records sent by email
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No transmission fee may be charged to the requester for transmitting public records via electronic mail.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Records are transmitted to the requester via electronic mail
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: No transmission fees may be charged to the record requester for transmitting public records via electronic mail.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed $0 for email transmission. Modeled as a parameter fixed at zero (rule_type Prohibition). Subsection number (1)(b) captured from opened source; verify exact placement in later pass.
